# Assign reading

Choose current material for a stated work purpose. Supply the question or
decision the reading should inform and a business contact for discussion.
Keep shared documentation routes in the plan. A person's assignment uses the
existing reading kind and an actual declared document-reading section instance;
use separate instances when reading outcomes are independent.

An arranged reading item needs a known owner and a nonsecret material reference.
Helper contacts are optional for this kind, though a discussion route should
be clear. Keep a stable unique id and an optional real planning target. Missing
details may remain pending, requested or deferred; supplied unknown section
or contact references are invalid. Do not copy restricted content into a note.

Check that the material is accessible for the intended role or arrange an
approved alternative. A link sent or an arranged assignment is not evidence
of reading or understanding. Preserve open questions and stale-content reports
instead of marking the newcomer's outcome from onboarder task status.
